status: Approved architecture study; no hardware demonstrated

head_mounted_mass.note: Track tether and backpack carried mass separately; all mass assumptions explicit

boards.head: OV9281, adjustable close-focus optics, axial IR LEDs, sensor decoupling
boards.interface: Serializer, local sensor/serializer supplies, protection, tether connector
boards.base: Deserializer, P4, memory, USB, host control and future auxiliary sensors

recording.streaming: Uncompressed primary; compression optional at base; never assumed to meet throughput
recording.timing: Frame counter, exposure configuration and dropped-frame detection required; distinguish exposure timestamp from host arrival

optics.focus: Adjustable threaded holder preferred; actual lens remains provisional
optics.crop: No sensor crop silently substituted for full image-circle coverage
optics.illumination: Two LEDs opposite the lens along module long axis, default off; no eye-use qualification

tether.topology: Two controlled-impedance signal conductors + supply + return, shield additional; compare micro-coax if superior
tether.connector: Small/light candidate envelope, exact connector and pin order NOT assigned; JST appearance is not protocol compatibility
tether.qualification: DC voltage drop, impedance/loss, bend/strain and shield termination must be validated

deployment.mouse: Base station fixed above enclosure; tether pull/torsion must be qualified
deployment.larger_animal: Same electronics on backpack; backpack mass and heat reported separately

boundaries: No claim of physical fit or streaming
Public documentation required; preserve source/license provenance
